faqs.q: Sec. 54-152. - Notice of illegally parked vehicles.
faqs.a:
Whenever any vehicle is found to be stopped, standing, or parked in violation of any
               restriction imposed by this Code, any police officer, any employee of the city, parking
               enforcement operator hired by the city, or other person designated by the chief of
               police to issue parking citations finding such vehicle may take its registration or
               identification number or any other information displayed on the vehicle that may identify
               its owner, and shall affix to the windshield or other conspicuous place on the vehicle
               a civil parking citation. The leaving of such parking citation constitutes sufficient
               notice to the registered owner or driver of the violation.
Any parking citation issued for a parking violation pursuant to this division shall
               contain the following statement: "Any vehicle parked in violation of local parking
               laws may be towed without further notice."
(
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
